issue.title: QOS SAI: PG shared Watermark test cannot be run on TH2

failure.body:
**Description**
The test currently uses scheduler/ port pause for egress port to accumulate packets and test the various buffer parameters. This method does not work for PG shared WM case on Th2.

This issue is a placeholder to revisit this testcase and make use of traffic generator for this testcase.

resolution.title: [qos] Enable PG Shared Watermark tests on Th2
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Neetha John <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Based on vendor recommendation, updated the pg shared wm tests to read only the shared watermark. With this method, pg shared wm can be run on Th2

Summary:
Fixes #1626

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test with the changes on Th2 and Mellanox and it passed
